---
title: "After the session"
---

The session stops before two parts of the exercise that need more time than it has: the causal graph of the claim, which Task 2 of the [browser lab](../../cases/eu-frames/lab.qmd#task-4-estimand-and-dag) lets you finish, and the preregistration of one analysis before it runs, which is Task 5 of the lab. Both are set out in the [exercise overview](../../cases/eu-frames/exercise.qmd), and both also run in the downloadable workspace, which the [setup page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html) of the AR4DS site installs.

The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers what the session could only mention, in modules that each stand on their own:

- [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) sets out the ideas behind the curve, the three purposes that a multiverse can serve, and the arguments made against it.
- [The items behind the scales](../../companion/measurement.qmd) takes the item battery of the Eurobarometer question apart: its dimensions, its reliability and what the choice of items does to the curve.
- [Weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd) sets the survey weights within a country-year against the regression weights across them, and the average European against the average country.
- [Panel data](../../companion/panel-data.qmd) works through the estimators of the menu, from pooled OLS to the within–between model, and the problem of few clusters.
- [Meta-analysis](../../companion/meta-analysis.qmd) puts the five analysts on one scale and asks why five analyses of one dataset are not five studies.
- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd) follows the public record of the claim through the OSF, and [Data sources](../../companion/data-sources.qmd) shows the route to the Eurobarometer files at GESIS.

The [one-day workshop](../eu-frames-one-day/index.qmd) takes the same case in four parts, with the causal graph and the preregistration in them, and the [Extended course](../eu-frames-extended/index.qmd) adds a day on open research and the tools before it and a day on the methods of the case, down to the respondents of the surveys, after it.
